Once completed we will return to site to mount the framed zone plan adjacent to the main fire alarm panel. Please note: If editable CAD drawings are provided prior to our attendance we may be able to reduce the cost of mapping out site.<\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\"> <\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\">Upon completion the works will be tested. <\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\"> <\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\">We have allowed for these works to be carried out during normal working hours. <\/div>","Notes":"<div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\"><strong>07:48 17\/03\/2021 Daniel Stratton - Zone plan previously quoted <\/strong><\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\"><strong><\/strong><\/div><div style=\"font-size: 10pt;\">Observed fused spur does not have a LED status indicator or require a special tool to operate. Propose replacement fused spur with these properties, using the existing cabling.<br \/>Observed no graphic zone chart adjacent to the fire panel. Propose installation of an up to date graphic zone plan.
